Maria G: Quick heads-up — ran a targeted perf sweep for Mixtral-like topology with paged KV layout. Observed serious p99 regressions when num_key_value_heads != num_attention_heads (esp. 64 vs 80). p50 looks fine. attaching numbers in thread.

Kevin L: can you paste the profiler slice? curious if it's kernel selection thrash or just more page faults.

Maria G: here are the hot lines from the microbench (trimmed):
```
model: mixtral-8x-kv
config: heads=80 kv_heads=64 kv_dim=128 paged_kv=true
throughput: 2.1 req/s (seq=512)
latencies: p50=48ms p95=210ms p99=432ms
kernel_switches: 78k/min
kv_page_faults: 3.4/min
cache_frag_ratio: 0.62
```

Jon P: wow that's a big p99. possible causes: (1) runtime picking smaller CUDA kernels due to uneven head dims, (2) batcher coalescing failing and producing stragglers, or (3) paged-KV compaction kicking in. did you capture tracer with kernel names?

Kevin L: i have a small snippet from the tracer showing kernel churn — note the alternating kernels around KV gather step:
```
[TRACE] conv_attn_kern_v1 (t=0.012s)
[TRACE] attn_kern_small_heads (t=0.013s)
[TRACE] kv_gather_paged (t=0.014s)
[TRACE] attn_kern_small_heads (t=0.020s)
[TRACE] conv_attn_kern_v1 (t=0.021s)
```

Lee T: looks like kernel selection is oscillating based on head count/kv layout. we saw this pattern before when num_kv_heads mismatched and the kernel hint falls back to generic path. you can force a kernel to test: add `kernel_override: conv_attn_kern_v1` to the runtime route config for a short run.

Maria G: thanks — i ran that override for 30m. p99 dropped to ~260ms and kernel_switches reduced 6x. throughput improved 25%. so kernel selection is a big part of it.

Samir R: good data. two follow-ups: (a) batching heuristics — when we see mixed head counts, the continuous batcher should split by effective kernel signature instead of greedy fill. That avoids a single straggler triggering fallback. (b) KV sizing: if kv_dim * kv_heads leads to non-power-of-two tile sizes we get slow paths and fragmentation. we should add a balancer that nudges kv_head grouping to prefer divisors of warp width.

Jon P: +1. here's a short bench command if folks want to reproduce locally: `./bench --model mixtral-8x-kv --heads 80 --kv-heads 64 --kv-dim 128 --seq 512 --trace kernels,kv`

InfraBot: deployment note — test override `kernel_override` applied to canary group at 1935012400 by Maria G. Monitor p99 and kernel_switches. :robot_face:

Lee T: i'll open a small RFC for: (1) kernel-selection hysteresis to avoid churning when head signatures flip, (2) batching-key split by kernel_signature, (3) a KV-layout health metric (frag_ratio) surfaced in console.

Maria G: perfect. next steps: Lee to RFC + quick sim, Kevin to add trace gating to batcher so we can correlate batch composition -> kernel choice, Jon/Samir to run bench matrix (heads x kv_heads x kv_dim). i'll collect runs in the perf doc. thanks all :thumbsup:
